note: Trainer-only. The seeded defects present in the SUT build, and the test names that prove each one. A defect counts as detected when at least one failing test name contains one of its `detectedBy` fragments.

defects.spec: R1 — a GTIN is any sequence of 13 or 14 digits
detectedBy: rejects anything that is not 13 or 14 digits
rejects a GTIN that is not 13 or 14 digits

defects.spec: R2 — deactivating a company marks all of its products hidden
defects.actual: The company is flagged but its products stay visible, including in the public API
detectedBy: hides every product of the company when it is deactivated
removes the hidden products from the public API
hides every product of a deactivated company

defects.spec: R4 — the products JSON paginates 10 per page
defects.actual: 20 products per page, so per_page and total_pages are wrong
detectedBy: paginates ten products per page
serves a different set of products on page two

defects.spec: R4 — next_page_url and prev_page_url point forward and backward
detectedBy: links to the next page and not to a previous one
links back and stops linking forward

defects.spec: R6 — the keyword matches name, name in French, description and description in French
defects.actual: Only the English fields are searched
detectedBy: searches each of the four translated fields
filters the listing by keyword across both languages

defects.spec: R3 — only a hidden product may be deleted permanently
defects.actual: Any product can be deleted, visible ones included
detectedBy: refuses to delete a visible product

defects.spec: R8 — the all valid banner appears only when every submitted code is valid
defects.actual: The banner appears as soon as one code is valid
detectedBy: does not show the all valid banner when one code is unknown

defects.spec: R9 — the public product page serves English or French with a matching lang attribute
defects.actual: The language parameter is ignored, the page is always English
detectedBy: switches to french content and the french lang attribute

defects.spec: S1 — no parameter reaches the database as concatenated SQL
defects.actual: The keyword is interpolated into a raw WHERE clause, wildcards included
detectedBy: treats an injection payload in the API keyword
treats an injection payload in the admin search
never returns a database error message
does not let a wildcard payload widen the result set

defects.spec: S2 — is_hidden, id and timestamps are not client-writable
defects.actual: The model is filled from the raw request, so a form can publish or hide a product
detectedBy: ignores an is_hidden flag submitted with a new product
ignores an is_hidden flag submitted with an update

defects.spec: R7 / S3 — management functions answer 401 without a session
defects.actual: The gate redirects to the login page instead, so an unauthenticated client sees 302
detectedBy: answers 401, not a redirect
answers 401 for every management route
answers 401 for a management page requested as a document

defects.spec: S4 — only image files up to 2 MB are accepted as a product image
defects.actual: Any file is accepted, an executable included
detectedBy: rejects an executable disguised as an upload
rejects an image with a double extension
rejects an image larger than 2 MB
rejects a file that is not an image

defects.spec: S5 — the passphrase form is rate limited and the comparison is constant time
defects.actual: The rate limiter was removed and the comparison is a plain string compare
detectedBy: rate limits repeated wrong passphrases
does not authenticate the session while the limiter is tripped

defects.spec: R5 / S6 — a hidden product answers 404 on the single product endpoint
defects.actual: Hidden products are served in full through the JSON API
detectedBy: answers 404 for a hidden product
answers 404 on the single product endpoint

defects.spec: S7 — stored free text is escaped wherever it is rendered
defects.actual: The product name and description are rendered with {!! !!}: stored XSS executes
detectedBy: escapes a product name and description on the admin product page
escapes the product name on the public product page

defects.spec: S8 — a failed request never returns a stack trace, a file path or SQL
defects.actual: Failures fall through to the framework renderer, leaking exception messages, paths and traces
detectedBy: answers a failed deletion without leaking internals
answers a failing request without leaking internals
